n04-luis-gets-dressed.observed_description: Luis, barefoot in khaki chinos and his navy T-shirt (already on, covering his chest), stands by the bed in front of an open oak wardrobe and pulls the hem down at both sides with natural five-finger hands, arms not crossed, looking down with a small smile. Folded grey sleep T-shirt and dark pajama pants lie on the navy duvet; rolled navy socks and navy sneakers wait by his bare feet. Identity matches t20; reads as finishing getting dressed at 180 px; the 4:5 crop keeps him whole (his left elbow touches the crop edge) and trims the sneakers, which are expendable.

n05-ana-gets-dressed.observed_description: Ana, in jeans, a white top and the sage overshirt, straightens its collar with both hands by an open oak wardrobe, smiling at the camera; light-blue pajamas lie on the cream bed and white sneakers wait on the floor. Identity, hands and the getting-dressed action read well.
n05-ana-gets-dressed.rejection: A large out-of-focus lamp in the foreground fills the lower right third of the photo (and part of the 4:5 crop), with a white blur band at the right edge; and Ana stands where the bed is, her lower legs hidden by the duvet and her feet showing under the bed frame, which is physically impossible.
